chapters.label: Athens, 2007
chapters.text: Athens, 2007, the Champions League final. Inzaghi has already scored once. Now Kaká slides a pass through... Inzaghi is gone! Round the keeper... two–nil Milan!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch again. Inzaghi waits on the shoulder of the last defender, and he runs the moment Kaká passes.

chapters.label: Round the keeper
chapters.text: From behind the goal. He takes the ball round the keeper, and rolls it into the empty net!

chapters.label: On the shoulder
chapters.text: Stay on the shoulder of the last defender, and go the moment the pass is played!
